name: Roots & Rivers Collective
description: Roots & Rivers Collective brings together community organisers, permaculturalists and regenerative land practitioners across the Northern Rivers of NSW. Through gatherings, working bees and shared meals, the collective connects people around growing food, caring for land and strengthening local food security. It’s a space to share skills, build relationships and turn ideas into practical community action.
